profile.summary: LangCell is a single-cell language model trained on pairs of single-cell transcriptomes and text descriptions of cell identity. It places cells and text in one shared feature space, so it can annotate cell types zero-shot by matching a cell against text descriptions of candidate types, as well as after few-shot training or fine-tuning.

summary_quotes.text: we propose an innovative solution by constructing a unified representation of single-cell data and natural language during the pre-training phase

LangCell is the only single-cell PLM that can work effectively in zero-shot cell identity understanding scenarios

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: LangCell has a cell encoder and a text encoder. The cell encoder is initialised from a pre-trained Geneformer and takes Geneformer-style tokenised cells, with a [CLS] token whose embedding is projected into the shared space. The text encoder is initialised from PubMedBERT and has a cross-attention mode that scores whether a cell and a text match. Pre-training jointly optimises four losses: masked gene modelling, cell-cell contrastive learning, cell-text contrastive learning and cell-text matching. It runs in two stages: first the cell encoder alone with the first two losses, then all four.

quotes.text: We use pre-trained Geneformer (Theodoris et al., 2023) to initialize our cell encoder
The weights are initialized using PubMedBERT (Gu et al., 2021)

Masked Gene Modeling (MGM) and Cell-Cell Contrastive Learning (C-C), to enhance single-cell representation learning. Additionally, we employ Cell-Text Contrastive Learning (C-T) and Cell-Text Matching (CTM)
In the first stage, we initialize the cell encoder parameters using Geneformer and conduct unimodal training using only the LM GM and LC−C loss functions.
In the second stage, we initialize the text encoder parameters using PubMedBERT and engage in multimodal training using all four loss functions.

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: One checkpoint is distributed as a Google Drive folder, split into five modules: text_bert, cell_bert, text_proj, cell_proj and ctm_head. cell_bert is a standard Hugging Face BertModel and can be used alone as LangCell-CE. The checkpoint has no version label or hash in the README, so a result should name the repository commit and the date the checkpoint was downloaded.

sections.title: Intended uses
sections.body: Cell identity understanding, mainly cell type annotation: zero-shot from text descriptions, few-shot, and fine-tuning of the cell encoder. Text descriptions of new cell types can be written following the OBO Foundry examples the authors provide.

quotes.text: LangCell zero-shot cell type annotation
LangCell few-shot cell type annotation
You can use these as examples to write textual descriptions for new cell types.

facts.label: Model type
facts.value: Language-cell pre-trained model (multimodal single-cell and text) for cell identity understanding.

quotes.text: we introduce **LangCell**, the first **Lang**uage-**Cell** pre-training framework.

facts.label: Architecture
facts.value: Model configuration in paper Table C.0.1: vocabulary 25427, hidden size 512, 12 hidden layers, 8 attention heads, ReLU. The table does not say which encoder these describe; the vocabulary size suggests the cell encoder. Cell encoder initialised from Geneformer. Text encoder: BERT with pluggable cross-attention, initialised from PubMedBERT. Linear projections and a cell-text matching head.
facts.source_locator: arXiv Table C.0.1 and Section 3; README.md: Checkpoint

facts.label: Inputs
facts.value: Single-cell data read with scanpy and tokenised the same way as Geneformer; for zero-shot annotation, text descriptions of candidate cell types.

quotes.text: you can use `scanpy` to read any single-cell data and process it into a format accepted by the model. The processing method is similar to `Geneformer`.

facts.label: Outputs

strengths.text: Zero-shot cell type annotation from text descriptions, which the authors say other single-cell language models cannot do effectively.

quotes.text: LangCell is the only single-cell PLM that can work effectively in zero-shot cell identity understanding scenarios

strengths.text: Modular checkpoint: the cell encoder is a standard Hugging Face BertModel and can be fine-tuned alone.

quotes.text: cell_bert is the standard Huggingface BertModel

strengths.text: The 27.5 million cell-text pre-training set is public.

quotes.text: Released pre-training dataset [**scLibrary**]

limitations.text: The authors note that all pre-training texts come from the OBO Foundry, that it handles only transcriptomics, and that it cannot generate cells or text.

quotes.text: the pre-training texts are all from the OBO Foundry, which limits the diversity to a certain extent. LangCell also cannot yet analyze other single-cell omics such as scATAC-seq, and it does not include cell/text generation functions.

limitations.text: Weights are on Google Drive with no stated licence or version.

run_guide.summary: Clone the repository, install the pinned dependencies, download the checkpoint and run few-shot cell type annotation.
